column4: Pixel-art sprite in the style of 1990s Build-engine games (Duke Nukem 3D, Redneck Rampage): digitized and crudely retouched by hand, flat even lighting, chunky pixels, a limited muddy palette, low saturation. One object alone in the middle on a flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF background, no shadow, no border, no watermark: a small sheet of squared paper torn out of a school exercise book, a little crumpled, a few lines of hurried pencil scribble on it that are not real letters, a red drawing pin through its top. Drawn big and simple with a bold dark outline.
